title: Zeno
tagline: Buying Crypto(Matic) with fiat, Send crypto from Fiat,  Lending already held tokens, Swapping your tokens, All on the blockchain with lowest gas fees and as easy as buying donuts.
description: This project allows users to interact with crypto, allowing them the flexibility to buy, send, lend, swap crypto without worrying about the high gas cost, as this all is on the polygon network. Also, users have the functionality to view their transactions as to keep a record of all their transactions. We allow user to bridge their Fiat currency to this platform and allowing them to do all the financial transactions on a single platform.
how_its_made: This projects uses the moralis wallet authentication. In this project we have used React and Tailwindcss for Frontend, Solidity for smart contracts and Nodejs, Express js for Backend. We have used Moralis for Swapping as they provide 1inch plugins for that and the smart contract that we have built are deployed on Polygon
